scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Friday early cat-boarding drop-off usable while floor sealant work makes the apartment unavailable to pets.
Emerging Need: The boarding stay has not begun, but the reservation lacks the vaccination certificate required before the health-file batch closes.
Decision Context: Observable notices establish the floor-work timing, early-shift constraint, reserved boarding hold, blank health file, and closure time; the pet workpad holds the certificate label, valid-through detail, profile inbox, and no-paid-intake preference.
Consequence: While the batch remains open, supplying the prerequisite can preserve the no-extra-intake drop-off; after closure, the same record cannot clear Friday intake.

parameter.body: The kitchen floor sealant visit for your unit is confirmed for Friday, February 20, 2026. Pets must be out of the unit from 08:00 Friday until ventilation clearance at 10:00 Saturday. Please leave the kitchen path empty before the crew arrives.

parameter.description: Medication-room coverage block; limited ability to handle pet logistics after departure. Reservation hold authorization for Pebble, Friday 07:15 drop-off through Saturday pickup.

parameter.subject: Health file status for reservation NLC-2187
parameter.body: Reservation NLC-2187 remains held for Friday 07:15 lobby drop-off. Health-file status shows no vaccination certificate received. The Friday early-drop document batch closes today at 16:30; files not cleared in that batch cannot use lobby drop-off tomorrow.

parameter.body: The 16:30 health-file batch for Friday early drop-off is closed. Reservation NLC-2187 has no vaccination certificate on file, so Friday 07:15 lobby drop-off cannot be cleared; the next standard document review is Monday unless a paid wellness intake is booked separately.
